name: skywalking
readme_excerpt: Apache SkyWalking SkyWalking: an APM (Application Performance Monitoring) system, especially designed for microservices, cloud native and container-based architectures. Abstract SkyWalking is an open-source APM system that provides monitoring, tracing and diagnosing capabilities for distributed systems in Cloud Native architectures. Distributed Tracing End-to-end distributed tracing. Service topology analysis, service-centric observability and APIs dashboards. Agents for your stack Java, .Net C…
